name: Turnal
body:
The turnal are a humanoid-raptor species with no wings or feathers. Their bodies are lithe and thin with bone crests on their head that sweep backward. Females have more intricate and pronounced crests than males, otherwise it is difficult to tell the genders apart. Turnal have a thick metal-infused carapace that develops around their bodies to protect them from the harsh elements of their home planet. They have predatory split-jaw mandibled-mouths and forward-facing avian?like eyes. They also have sharp foot-claws that can be dangerous in close combat. Their skin is typically shades of white, gray, or light brown, but their carapace pieces are much more colorful. They also practice a system of ritual tattooing to add more coloration to their carapace and to tell tales of their exploits and achievements.

Turnal, unlike other avian species, give birth to live young and have lifespans similar to humans.

Turnal are a rigid and law-abiding race with strict hierarchies and work ethic, with their military being the center of their culture. They have seen the value of diplomacy and cooperation with other cultures. Within turnal society, there is a strong sense of civic duty which can extend to very good friends and neighbors.

Relations: Turnal have good relations with other cultures who have a strict sense of honor and disdain more tribal and violent cultures. They currently refrain from open warfare unless the need arises, at which time, they fully commit. They are poor merchants so also seek good relations with other cultures that can aid them in that manner.

Alignment and Religion: Turnal typically do not worship deities but instead participate in ancestor spirit, or a kind of zeitgeist spirit worship. That said, there is no prohibition to religion among turnal, but they still tend to avoid chaotic deities and faiths.

Adventurers: Turnal adventurers are common, either by being sent out on missions by their own people or to seek to improve their own abilities.

Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Turnal are nimble and strong of mind but lacking in negotiation skills. They gain a +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and a -2 Charisma.
Size: Turnal are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: Turnal are Humanoids with the turnal subtype.
Base Speed: Turnal have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Turnal begin play speaking turnal and common. Turnal with high Intelligence scores can choose from any non-secret language.
Natural Armor: Turnal gain a +1 natural armor bonus to their Armor Class.
Spell Resistant: A turnal’s carapace contains certain metals that inhibit magic. They gain a spell resistance equal to 6 + their character level.
Keen Sight: Turnal gain a +2 bonus on sight?based Perception checks.
Nimble: Turnal gain a +1 bonus on Acrobatics and Escape Artist checks.
Poor Negotiator: Turnal have a difficulty gauging the value of things and take a -2 penalty to Appraise checks.
Claw: Turnal have dangerous claws on their feet, though given their bipedal nature can only use one at a time quickly in combat. They gain a single claw attack as a primary natural attack that deals 1d3 damage
Low-Light Vision: Turnal can see twice as far as a race with normal vision in conditions of dim light.
Military Honor: Turnal see the military as their highest honor, and some see the martial discipline as higher than their original primal instincts. These turnal file down their foot claws as an honor exercise and train with more honorable manufactured weapons. They gain proficiency with one weapon for which they do not gain proficiency by nature of their class. A turnal can take this trait in place of claw.
Primal Turnal: Some turnal have turned to their primal turnal roots. They gain a 1d3 bite attack as a primary natural attack, however, they do not learn common. However, these primal turnal can only learn common, auran, akana, and draconic with a high Intelligence score.
Thicker Armor: Some turnal develop a thicker carapace than others of their kind. This offers more protection, but restricts some of their movements. Their spell resistance is to 11 + their character level and their natural armor bonus is +2. However, their speed is reduced to 20 feet. Their speed is not reduced further by armor or encumbrance. A turnal can take this trait in place of natural armor, nimble, and spell resistant.
Turnal Spellcaster: Some turnal have sought to rid their carapace of the magic-dampening metals in lieu of ones that amplify their magic. Such turnal gain a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks including overcoming spell resistance and casting defensively. A turnal can take this trait in place of spell resistant.
Turnal Stalker: Some turnal are devoted to the protection of their kind by hunting and stalking their enemies. Such turnal always treat Perception and Stealth as class skills and gain a +1 bonus to both. A turnal can take this trait in place of keen sight and nimble.
